function.name: rc_think_aloud
function.description: Record Agent's thinking process (what and why)

content.description: What the Agent is thinking (e.g., 'Considering PE due to sudden dyspnea')

internal_reasoning.description: Why Agent thinks this way (detailed reasoning process)

confidence.description: Optional caller-supplied compatibility metadata; not clinical probability or calibrated confidence

potential_biases.description: Cognitive biases that might affect this thinking

function.name: rc_reflect
function.description: Agent reflects on its own reasoning process (meta-cognition)

reflection_content.description: What the Agent realized during reflection

identified_biases.description: Cognitive biases identified in own reasoning

function.name: rc_identify_gaps
function.description: Agent proactively identifies knowledge/evidence gaps

impact_on_diagnosis.description: How this gap affects diagnostic confidence

suggested_actions.description: Suggested actions to fill the gap

function.name: rc_challenge_assumption
function.description: Agent challenges its own assumptions (devil's advocate)

challenge_reasoning.description: Why this assumption might be wrong

alternative_scenario.description: Alternative scenario if assumption is false

impact_if_wrong.description: Impact on diagnosis if assumption is wrong

function.name: rc_get_thinking_chain
function.description: Get complete thinking chain (cognitive audit trail)

include_alternatives.description: Include alternatives that were considered but rejected

function.name: rc_add_evidence
function.description: Add structured evidence with automatic quality grading and provenance tracking

source_document.description: Stable document_id from the session source manifest; legacy sessions without a manifest may use a local path

raw_snippet.description: Exact literal excerpt or data line from the raw source document for deterministic lineage

content_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the raw snippet

extraction_method.description: Method used to extract this finding

temporal.description: Typed source time. Only kind='instant' with an explicit source timezone offset is chronologically sortable or can support a causation-temporality check. Date, range, relative, and unknown remain valid evidence without negative or ordering inference.

raw_value.description: Exact source time expression; null only when the source contains no time expression and kind='unknown'.

precision.description: Optional caller hint; the server derives and emits canonical precision from the supplied representation.

normalized_start.description: Required for a range when raw_value is not an ISO start/end pair; use YYYY-MM-DD or an aware ISO datetime.

normalized_end.description: Required for a range when raw_value is not an ISO start/end pair; use the same date/aware-datetime domain as start.

timezone_provenance.description: Optional caller declaration; the server derives the safe canonical value and never assumes a timezone.

event_timestamp.description: Legacy compatibility alias for temporal.kind='instant' only. It must contain 'T' and an explicit Z or numeric timezone offset. Use temporal for date-only, range, relative, or unknown time.

auto_verify.description: Automatically verify snippet against physical file on disk if available

function.name: rc_get_evidence
function.description: Retrieve evidence by ID

function.name: rc_verify_evidence
function.description: Verify evidence against raw physical files or record independent reviewer audit

verified_by.description: Named reviewer or deterministic verifier actor

manual_confirmation.description: Explicitly assert independent human review. The reviewer must be present in the operator-controlled ROOTCAUSE_AUTHORIZED_REVIEWERS allowlist.

raw_snippet.description: Verbatim quote to search and verify in the source file on disk

document_id.description: Optional stable document_id. Manifest-bound evidence cannot be rebound to a different source; legacy sessions may use a local file path override

function.name: rc_propose_hypothesis
function.description: Propose one differential diagnosis with explicit reasoning and uncertainty. Omission of prior_probability uses a neutral 0.5 UNCALIBRATED implementation baseline; it is not a patient-specific clinical probability or certainty label.

prior_probability.description: Numeric Bayesian starting value. Omission uses a neutral 0.5 UNCALIBRATED implementation baseline, not a clinical probability or certainty label.

must_not_miss.description: Mark an explicitly reviewed high-harm diagnosis that must be ruled out

mechanism_category.description: Broad etiologic mechanism. UNKNOWN is valid during preliminary investigation but does not count toward final DDx breadth.

diagnostic_role.description: Role of the candidate: etiologic disease/process, observed syndrome, downstream complication, mimic, or unknown.

certainty.description: Explicit qualitative certainty. It is never inferred from a default or uncalibrated numeric probability.

reasoning_basis.description: Whether the diagnosis itself is source-documented, is a mechanism inference from observations, or has unknown basis.

clinical_reasoning.description: REQUIRED: Detailed clinical reasoning for why this diagnosis is being considered (e.g., 'Patient has chest pain + elevated troponin + ECG changes')

differential_diagnoses_considered.description: DEPRECATED context-only notes. Propose every plausible candidate as its own hypothesis. This array cannot replace rc_audit_differential_breadth or justify exclusion.

evidence_supporting.description: DEPRECATED context-only input; it is not persisted and does not create evidence links. Use rc_link_evidence_to_hypothesis once per supporting evidence association.

evidence_contradicting.description: DEPRECATED context-only input; it is not persisted and does not create evidence links. Use rc_link_evidence_to_hypothesis once per contradicting evidence association.

uncertainty_factors.description: REQUIRED: Factors contributing to diagnostic uncertainty (e.g., 'Troponin trend pending')

confidence_rationale.description: REQUIRED: Why the candidate is considered and the calibration/source limitations of any numeric prior

exclusion_criteria.description: Criteria that would rule out this diagnosis

name.description: Diagnostic test or observation to obtain

purpose.description: Typed relationship of the test to the hypothesis

expected_supporting_result.description: Result pattern that would support the hypothesis

expected_refuting_result.description: Result pattern that would refute the hypothesis

planned_tests.description: Typed pending tests bound by the server to the newly created hypothesis; free-text gaps are not equivalent

function.name: rc_audit_differential_breadth
function.description: Persist a systematic differential-breadth audit. Select a syndrome-appropriate framework, review every canonical cell, retain insufficient data with planned discriminators, and record why expansion stopped. This proves coverage, not diagnostic truth.

BreadthCellStatus.description: Four-state review outcome; uncertainty is retained, not treated as exclusion.
BreadthCellStatus.title: BreadthCellStatus

BreadthDiscriminatorKind.description: Kind of prospective information used to resolve an uncertain cell.
BreadthDiscriminatorKind.title: BreadthDiscriminatorKind

BreadthDiscriminatorStatus.description: Pending lifecycle state for a breadth-level discriminator.
BreadthDiscriminatorStatus.title: BreadthDiscriminatorStatus

DifferentialBreadthAuditRole.description: Whether an audit is the main or a supplementary coverage framework.
DifferentialBreadthAuditRole.title: DifferentialBreadthAuditRole

DifferentialBreadthCell.description: Review outcome for one canonical or custom framework cell.
DifferentialBreadthCell.title: DifferentialBreadthCell

DifferentialBreadthFramework.description: Supported clinical frameworks for systematic DDx expansion.
DifferentialBreadthFramework.title: DifferentialBreadthFramework

MechanismCategory.description:
Broad etiologic mechanism used to audit DDx breadth.

The categories deliberately follow a VINDICATE-style axis instead of an
organ-system axis.  ``UNKNOWN`` is an honest preliminary value and never
counts toward the final mechanism-breadth gate.
MechanismCategory.title: MechanismCategory

PlannedBreadthDiscriminator.description: Typed prospective data/test needed to resolve insufficient information.
PlannedBreadthDiscriminator.title: PlannedBreadthDiscriminator

audit.description: One persisted review proving that a broad framework was actually applied.
audit.title: DifferentialBreadthAudit

function.name: rc_link_evidence_to_hypothesis
function.description: Link one evidence item to one hypothesis with Bayesian updating. The supplied LR is applied directly: >1 supports, <1 refutes, and 1.0 is neutral. A non-neutral LR additionally needs a verified local literature calibration evidence record.

likelihood_ratio.description: Applied likelihood ratio: LR+ (>1) if supports, LR- (<1) if contradicts; it is never inverted by the server

supports.description: True only with LR>1, false only with LR<1, and null with neutral LR=1. Omit to derive this direction from LR.

rationale.description: Clinical justification plus source/calibration limitation; required by the handler whenever LR is not neutral 1.0

calibration_status.description: SOURCE_CALIBRATED requires a verified local evidence-ledger calibration record; QUANTITATIVELY_UNKNOWN requires direct likelihood_ratio=1.0 and does not count as support/refutation.

calibration_source_ref.description: EVD-* ID of a verified LITERATURE record in this case evidence ledger. The record must preserve the exact quantitative snippet, document location, extraction method, and content hash. Citation-looking caller strings are not admitted.

function.name: rc_get_differential_diagnosis
function.description: Get the differential diagnosis in stable working-ledger order; uncalibrated compatibility values are never used for rank or filtering

min_probability.description: Deprecated compatibility argument; accepted but ignored because no calibrated clinical probability is established

function.name: rc_select_leading_hypothesis
function.description: Explicitly select one ACTIVE or CONFIRMED hypothesis as the current leading diagnosis. This appends a typed audit record; numeric compatibility values and array order never select a lead.

reason.description: Why this candidate is selected as leading now

function.name: rc_exclude_hypothesis
function.description: Rule out a hypothesis based on evidence

exclusion_reason.description: Why this hypothesis is being excluded

function.name: rc_get_reasoning_chain
function.description: Get complete reasoning chain with audit trail

function.name: rc_export_reasoning_chain
function.description: Export reasoning chain to JSON or Mermaid format

output_path.description: Output file path (optional, auto-generated if not provided)

function.name: rc_audit_reasoning_state
function.description: Audit clinical reasoning completeness, stage progression, missing prerequisites, and next recommended actions for AI agents

function.name: rc_detect_conflicts
function.description: Automatically detect clinical contradictions, paradoxical treatment reactions, guideline monitoring gaps (e.g. MTP without K+/ABG, high Propofol without lipids), and cognitive anchoring pitfalls across all evidence and hypotheses.

function.name: rc_create_checkpoint
function.description: Create an integrity-checked, timestamped snapshot of active clinical reasoning state (evidence, hypotheses, Bayesian history, thinking steps, reasoning chain) to prevent context loss or enable branching investigation.

notes.description: Optional notes describing the reason for this snapshot

created_by.description: Agent or reviewer creating the checkpoint

function.name: rc_restore_checkpoint
function.description: Restore clinical reasoning aggregate and database state from a saved checkpoint.

checkpoint_file.description: Checkpoint JSON filename or path inside this session's checkpoint directory (optional)

function.name: rc_list_checkpoints
function.description: List all available case checkpoints and snapshot metadata for a session.

function.name: rc_generate_contract_report
function.description: Generate CONTRACT-level auditable report with evidence chain and reasoning

include_quality_metrics.description: Include evidence coverage and quality metrics

detail_level.description: Markdown artifact detail; ignored by JSON/FHIR

locale.description: Built-in Markdown renderer locale; JSON/FHIR clinical data are not translated

audience.description: Markdown explanation audience. clinician preserves recorded English medical terminology and expands DDx evidence, unknowns, and discriminating tests

template_file.description: Optional path to custom Markdown report template file (e.g. 'config/templates/clinical_reasoning_report_template.md')

finalize.description: Finalize only after readiness, conflict, manifest, and reviewer gates pass

approved_by.description: Explicit reviewer identity from ROOTCAUSE_AUTHORIZED_REVIEWERS; required when finalize=true

function.name: rc_verify_causation
function.description: Compatibility name for a conservative causation audit; this tool does not establish clinical causality. It checks submitted obligations using the Counterfactual Testing Framework. Tests: 1) Temporality - Did cause precede effect? 2) Necessity - Would effect occur without cause? 3) Mechanism - Is there a plausible causal pathway? 4) Sufficiency - Is cause alone sufficient for effect?

cause.description: Proposed root event. For a durable/final-eligible audit, id, description, and evidence must exactly match the persisted Why root and clinical evidence ledger.

id.description: Stable Why/root-cause node ID when applicable

timestamp.description: Canonical cause datetime containing 'T' and required Z or numeric timezone offset; omit for date-only or unknown/local time

evidence.description: Evidence IDs supporting the proposed cause event

effect.description: Effect event; every evidence reference must resolve in the clinical evidence ledger

timestamp.description: Canonical effect datetime containing 'T' and required Z or numeric timezone offset; omit for date-only or unknown/local time

evidence.description: Evidence IDs supporting the effect event

function.name: rc_validate_diagram
function.description: Audit, validate, and auto-sanitize Mermaid diagram syntax (flowchart, timeline, sequence, state, fishbone, why_tree). Checks delimiter balance, label quotes, colon formatting, and returns clean executable Mermaid source with diagnostics.

mermaid_source.description: Raw Mermaid source code or diagram definition to audit

diagram_type.description: Expected diagram type (optional, auto-detected if omitted)

auto_fix.description: Automatically escape reserved characters, balance brackets, and fix syntax

function.name: rc_render_timeline
function.description: Render structured chronological event timeline and Mermaid diagram using clinical patterns (perioperative_sequence, acute_crisis, delayed_diagnosis, barrier_failure, device_incident, auto, custom).

session_id.description: RCA session ID (optional, to load persisted clinical evidence)

temporal.description: Typed source time. Only kind='instant' with an explicit source timezone offset is chronologically sortable or can support a causation-temporality check. Date, range, relative, and unknown remain valid evidence without negative or ordering inference.

raw_value.description: Exact source time expression; null only when the source contains no time expression and kind='unknown'.

precision.description: Optional caller hint; the server derives and emits canonical precision from the supplied representation.

normalized_start.description: Required for a range when raw_value is not an ISO start/end pair; use YYYY-MM-DD or an aware ISO datetime.

normalized_end.description: Required for a range when raw_value is not an ISO start/end pair; use the same date/aware-datetime domain as start.

timezone_provenance.description: Optional caller declaration; the server derives the safe canonical value and never assumes a timezone.

event_timestamp.description: Legacy alias for an aware temporal.kind='instant' only.

time.description: Legacy display label. Without temporal/event_timestamp it is retained as unknown local time and is never chronologically sorted.

pattern.description: Clinical timeline pattern used for phase clustering

include_table.description: Include Markdown event matrix table in response

function.name: rc_suggest_hfacs
function.description: Suggest HFACS-MES classification codes for a cause description. Returns heuristic keyword-rule matches; their internal compatibility values are not calibrated confidence or clinical probability. HFACS-MES has 5 levels: External Factors, Organizational Influences, Unsafe Supervision, Preconditions, Unsafe Acts.

description.description: The cause description text to classify

domain.description: Optional domain context for better suggestions (e.g., 'anesthesia', 'surgery', 'nursing')

max_suggestions.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return

function.name: rc_confirm_classification
function.description: Persist an operator-authorized HFACS review for exactly one Fishbone cause in one session. CONFIRMED requires a recognized HFACS code; NOT_APPLICABLE forbids a code. A code supplied to rc_add_cause remains UNREVIEWED and cannot satisfy final conformance.

description.description: Optional exact cause description for an additional stale-data check

hfacs_code.description: Recognized HFACS-MES code; required only for CONFIRMED

reason.description: Auditable reason for the review disposition

confidence.description: Optional caller-supplied heuristic compatibility metadata; not clinical probability or calibrated confidence

function.name: rc_get_hfacs_framework
function.description: Get HFACS-MES framework structure and category definitions. Use this to understand the classification hierarchy and criteria.

level.description: Optional: specific level to retrieve (EF, OI, US, PC, UA). If not specified, returns all levels.

function.name: rc_list_learned_rules
function.description: List all learned classification rules. Shows rules that have been confirmed by experts.

hfacs_code.description: Optional: filter by specific HFACS code

min_confidence.description: Legacy heuristic-rule compatibility threshold; not calibrated confidence or clinical probability

function.name: rc_reload_rules
function.description: Reload classification rules from YAML files. Use this after manually editing config files.

function.name: rc_get_6m_hfacs_mapping
function.description: Get mapping between 6M Fishbone categories and HFACS codes. Shows how Fishbone categories (Personnel, Equipment, Material, Process, Environment, Monitoring) correspond to HFACS levels. Useful for cross-framework analysis and ensuring comprehensive coverage. Also provides Why Tree depth guidance for each category.

category.description: Optional: specific 6M category to retrieve mapping for. If not specified, returns all mappings.

function.name: rc_start_session
function.description: Start a new RCA analysis session. Creates a new session with the specified case type and title. Returns session_id for subsequent operations.

SourceDocument.description: Immutable identity and processing metadata for one source document.

document_id.description: Stable case-local source identifier; never use direct patient identifiers
document_id.title: Document Id

source_uri.description: URI or approved local path retained by the host; raw bytes are not embedded
source_uri.title: Source Uri

source_kind.description: For example progress_note, medication_record, imaging, or device_log
source_kind.title: Source Kind

de_identified.description: Host attestation; null means de-identification has not been established
de_identified.title: De Identified

independence_status.description: Whether this is an independently acquired source, a derivative of another manifest document, or not yet adjudicated

source_group_id.description: Host-declared independence group; documents in one group count as one source root for final conformance
source_group_id.title: Source Group Id

parent_document_id.description: Immediate manifest parent when independence_status is derived
parent_document_id.title: Parent Document Id

SourceDocument.title: SourceDocument

SourceIndependenceStatus.description: Relationship of a document to independently acquired clinical sources.
SourceIndependenceStatus.title: SourceIndependenceStatus

SourceReviewStatus.description: Processing state for one registered source document.
SourceReviewStatus.title: SourceReviewStatus

source_manifest.description: Versioned manifest for every raw record in scope. Register all sources, including documents from which no finding was extracted.

patient_key.description: Pseudonymous case-local patient key, never a direct identifier
patient_key.title: Patient Key

default_timezone.description: IANA timezone used when a source omits its timezone
default_timezone.title: Default Timezone

source_manifest.title: CaseInputManifest

function.name: rc_adjudicate_source
function.description: Append an authorized source-processing and independence review event without mutating the pinned source manifest or its digest. Use after extraction/review; reviewer must be allowlisted.

document_id.description: Stable document_id in the pinned manifest

de_identified.description: Human attestation; must be true for reviewed sources

parent_document_id.description: Manifest parent for a derived source

function.name: rc_get_session
function.description: Get details of an RCA session by ID. Returns session status, current stage, and progress.

function.name: rc_list_sessions
function.description: List all RCA sessions with optional filters. Returns summary of all sessions.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return

function.name: rc_archive_session
function.description: Archive a completed RCA session. Archived sessions are preserved but marked as inactive.

function.name: rc_init_fishbone
function.description: Initialize a Fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram for a session. Creates a 6M structure (Personnel, Equipment, Material, Process, Environment, Monitoring) with the problem statement as the fish head.

session_id.description: The session ID to create fishbone for

function.name: rc_add_cause
function.description: Add a cause to a Fishbone category. Each cause can have sub-causes and evidence. An optional HFACS code is only an UNREVIEWED candidate until rc_confirm_classification persists an authorized review.

hfacs_code.description: Optional unreviewed HFACS candidate code; never a confirmation

function.name: rc_get_fishbone
function.description: Get the complete Fishbone diagram for a session. Returns all categories and causes in structured format.

function.name: rc_export_fishbone
function.description: Export Fishbone diagram in various formats. Supports Mermaid, JSON, and Markdown formats.

function.name: rc_ask_why
function.description: Ask 'Why?' to drill down into root causes using 5-Why analysis. Creates or extends a WhyChain for the session. Each call goes one level deeper (up to 5 levels). This is the CORE tool for systematic root cause reasoning.

answer.description: The answer to 'Why?'. This becomes the basis for the next question. Example: 'Because the nurse miscalculated the dose'

parent_node_id.description: Optional: ID of parent node to branch from. If not provided, continues from the last node or creates first Why.

initial_problem.description: The initial problem statement. Required only for the FIRST Why in a chain.

function.name: rc_get_why_tree
function.description: Get the complete Why Tree (5-Why analysis chain) for a session. Shows all Why questions and answers in hierarchical format.

function.name: rc_mark_root_cause
function.description: Mark a WhyNode as the identified root cause. This indicates the analysis has reached a fundamental cause that requires action.

node_id.description: The WhyNode ID to mark as root cause

confidence.description: Optional caller-supplied compatibility metadata; not clinical probability or calibrated confidence

function.name: rc_export_why_tree
function.description: Export Why Tree in various formats. Supports Mermaid (flowchart), JSON, and Markdown.

function.name: rc_add_causal_link
function.description: Add a directed or bidirectional causal relationship between Why nodes. Use this to capture escalation loops, feedback cycles, or mitigation links that are not visible in a simple linear 5-Why chain.

bidirectional.description: Whether the influence also goes from target back to source

note.description: Optional explanatory note for this link

function.name: rc_build_teaching_case
function.description: Transform a completed Why Tree into a teaching-ready lesson plan. Generates learning objectives, common pitfalls, discussion prompts, and reverse-causality questions for medical learners.
